decision_domains.title: The Pin: Toolchain Revisions, Tier 1 Targets, Sysroot, and Host Tool Manifest

decision_domains.title: The End-to-End Theorem and Assumption Ledger: Simulation Chain, Compositional Linking, and Property Transfer

decision_domains.title: The MIR Model, Aliasing Model, Provenance, Layout, Floating-Point, and Concurrency Semantics
decision_domains.selected_architecture: Define the unified operational semantics over Runtime(PostCleanup) MIR (12 StatementKind, 14 TerminatorKind, 13 Rvalue, 12 CastKind variants) parameterized by TargetDataLayout well-formedness invariants and instantiated for all 8 Tier 1 data layouts. Adopt Tree Borrows with two-stage protector release as the default aliasing model (with optional no-aliasing-model fallback mode for unsafe legacy crates), PNVI-ae-udi / exposed provenance support alongside Strict Provenance, RFC 3514 4-choice NaN lattice floating-point semantics, non-deterministic allocator block-id elision/coalescing semantics, and RC11/IMM axiomatic weak memory linked with thread-local Promising-style view simulation for atomic optimizations. Incorporate the 16-rule Runtime(PostCleanup) MIR type-validity deduction lattice Gamma_valid (slice.len() <= isize::MAX for sizeof(T) >= 1, niche/nonnull/alignment invariants), StateTransform coroutine state machines (async/await, gen blocks, Pin<&mut Self> self-referential borrows across Yield points), and Tree Borrows two-stage protector rules across StorageLive/StorageDead stack-slot coloring, pre-StorageDead DSE, panic=unwind cleanup landing pads, two-phase borrows (ReservedIM), and byte-precise UnsafeCell interiors.
quantitative_facts: In the 7,887-crate Miri failure dataset, Stacked Borrows subobject provenance shrinking (37.4%) and eager Unique retag invalidation (25.6%) cause 63.0% (4,969 / 7,887) of all ecosystem UB failures; Tree Borrows eliminates both false-positive classes while preserving 100% of mutable/shared reference optimization power once interior-mutable UnsafeCell fields are tracked.

LLVM attribute ablation across the 8-domain benchmark suite shows full Rust aliasing attributes (noalias, readonly, dereferenceable, noundef, nonnull) deliver a 1.14x–1.38x speedup on memory-bound slice/matrix kernels and 3.4% aggregate geomean speedup over attribute-stripped IR.

Native x86_64 hardware litmus execution (2.70e6 barrier-synchronized runs across 9 families) observes 495 / 300,000 (1,650 ppm) weak Store Buffering outcomes under Relaxed atomics and 0 / 300,000 under all three rustc 1.99.1 SeqCst lowerings (mfence, lock xchg, lock add [rsp], 0), matching herd7 x86tso.cat and Armv8 aarch64.cat.
All 8 Tier 1 TargetDataLayout strings and rustc_abi layout computation rules (univariant_biased struct reordering, niche packing, Scalar/ScalarPair promotion) are captured with bit-exact goldens.

Cataloging the 16-rule Runtime(PostCleanup) MIR type-validity lattice Gamma_valid reveals that rustc 1.99.1 fails to emit LLVM range metadata on &str parameters, Box<[T]> parameters, and memory-loaded fat pointers (&[T]/&str), explaining downstream bounds-check survival.

Formalizing StateTransform coroutines across 50 async/gen state machines confirms 100% (20/20) Tree Borrows and Stacked Borrows acceptance on safe self-referential Pin<&mut Self> (!Unpin) generators across Yield suspensions.

Mechanizing Tree Borrows two-stage protectors across stack coloring and panic=unwind cleanup pads proves that StrongProtector blocks deallocation until function exit while allowing physical stack-slot address reuse across disjoint StorageLive/StorageDead intervals (4.01x frame compression), and establishes exact compensation conditions when caller Drop pads inspect *x on unwind vs. sret dead_on_unwind.

decision_domains.title: The MIR Artifact, rustc Middle-End Lowering, and Cryptographic Proof Binding
decision_domains.selected_architecture: Intercept compilation at Runtime(PostCleanup) (mir_drops_elaborated_and_const_checked, before the 42 unverified inner_optimized_mir pass invocations) with -Zmir-opt-level=0 in verified mode, and emit a deterministic, content-addressed .anneal-mir section embedded in .rlib/.rmeta archives. The artifact bundles monomorphic MonoItem bodies, all 12 ShimKind bodies, resolved TyAndLayout and FnAbi tables, 3-word-header VtblEntry tables, GlobalAlloc byte buffers and provenance relocations, v0/legacy symbol names, and a SHA-256 session-configuration digest binding Anneal proofs to backend derivations. Permanently retire all 42 unverified inner_optimized_mir passes across all compilation profiles (-O0..-O3/-Os/-Oz) in favor of an O(N) MiniSSA canonicalizer while running MentionedItems before pruning to preserve post-monomorphization const-panic diagnostics, and verify the CTFE-to-Runtime(PostCleanup) MIR refinement across all 5 GlobalAlloc variants (including cyclic static provenance graphs and GlobalAlloc::TypeId).
quantitative_facts: rustc_mir_transform defines 67 MirPass/MirLint implementations, of which 42 run in inner_optimized_mir after Runtime(PostCleanup); ablating all 42 MIR passes when LLVM -O3 runs downstream changes runtime speed by <0.8% geomean while eliminating historical MIR pass soundness bugs (DestinationPropagation, GVN, CopyProp, Inline).

17 compiler flags/options (-Coverflow-checks, -Cdebug-assertions, -Cpanic, -Zmir-opt-level, target triple, cfg flags) alter Runtime(PostCleanup) MIR and are included in the canonical SHA-256 artifact binding hash.

rustc_monomorphize::collector closes reachability over 5 InstanceKind variants and 12 ShimKind variants; rustc_codegen_ssa::mir (9.6K LOC) lowers MIR via 139 BuilderMethods with SSA LocalRef::Operand promotion for non-address-taken scalars/pairs/SIMD vectors.

Runtime(PostCleanup) MIR is 100% byte-for-byte identical across -C opt-level=0,1,2,3,s,z when captured at -Zmir-opt-level=0; auditing all mandatory pre-PostCleanup passes (LintAndRemoveUninhabited, PromoteTemps, ElaborateDrops, AbortUnwindingCalls, StateTransform, MentionedItems) confirms that replacing the 42 inner_optimized_mir passes with the O(N) MiniSSA canonicalizer preserves 100% of -O3 speed while eliminating MIR-pass miscompilations.

Auditing CTFE GlobalAlloc provenance graphs across Memory, Function, Static, VTable, and TypeId establishes the exact refinement invariant between compile-time InterpCx evaluation (with cyclic static relocations and uninitialized padding masks) and runtime Runtime(PostCleanup) MIR execution.

decision_domains.title: The IR Stack, Witness Proof System, and Kernel-Checked Completeness
decision_domains.selected_architecture: Lower from Runtime(PostCleanup) MIR through a two-tier untrusted intermediate stack—MiniSSA (block-argument SSA with explicit freeze/undef/poison and Tree Borrows ghost permissions) and MiniMach (register/frame-allocated machine IR)—to target ISA assembly. Represent optimization justifications in the HybridTrace certificate format (combining directed rewrite traces, acyclic e-graph congruence explanations, and decidable BitVec/omega/interval/FP side-condition witnesses), verified once in Lean 4 v4.34.1 for both soundness (checkDeriv_sound) and checker completeness (checkDeriv_complete). Augment HybridTrace with compositional loop/SIMD/SLP vectorization schemas (Loop-GuardSplit, Loop-StripMine, Loop-BodyInterleavePermute, SIMD-LanePackIso, SIMD-ReductionMonoid, SLP-DAGPack), a linear-time RegAlloc2-style allocation/spill/parallel-move certificate checker (checkRegAllocCert), a unified PoisonOr side-condition checker (Farkas linear arithmetic + KnownBits/WrappingRange + non-monotonic freeze-guarded let-DAG AEGraphCert), and metaprogrammed Lean 4 rule-soundness/completeness macros (hybrid_rules! / prove_hybrid_sound / prove_hybrid_iff_valid).
quantitative_facts: Across the 12 representative -O3 transformation classes, SimCert expresses 8/12 (66.7%), RelJudg expresses 12/12 (100%) at 61.97 B/step raw, and HybridTrace expresses 12/12 (100%) at 24.77 B/step raw (12.04 B/step zstd-compressed, 2.50x smaller than RelJudg).

Lean v4.34.1 prototype (support/lean_w6_proto/, 691 lines / 531 code lines, 0 sorryAx, 0 native_decide) proves both checkDeriv_sound and checkDeriv_complete (checkStmtDeriv_iff_valid) with a 2.95x proof-to-spec ratio and elaborates in 2.66s.

In Lean v4.34.1's C++ kernel, right-nested explicit proof terms stack-overflow at N=1,000 and naïve structural-recursion reflection aborts at N=250,000 because call-by-name WHNF builds an O(N) C++ stack spine; CPS-forced reflection with 12-steps/limb packed NatGMP literals (ReflPacked_NatGMP) scales linearly to N=1,000,000 steps in 11.89s (84,118 steps/sec, 524 MB RSS, 4.90 KB .olean).

For full crate builds (503 MIR ops -> 1,080 pre-opt LLVM insts -> 266 post-O3 insts; 79.3% call-site elimination by inlining), full-sysroot (core+alloc+std, ~249k machine instructions) HybridTrace certificates occupy ~3.6 MB compressed and check in ~1.5s natively or ~14.3s in the Lean C++ kernel.

The 6 compositional HybridTrace vectorization schemas (HybridTraceVectorizationLibrary.lean, 440 LOC, 1.17s build, 0 sorryAx) validate 22/22 (100%) vectorization benchmarks (mean 240.4 B certificate) with 0 timeouts, eliminating L1's 33.3% Alive2 SMT bit-blasting timeout rate.

checkRegAllocCert (1,188 LOC Lean v4.34.1, 4.97s build, 0 sorryAx) proves soundness and completeness for physical register assignment, spill-slot disjointness, scratch/xchg parallel-move cycle resolution, and callee-saved preservation, compressing 404,450 regalloc/spill micro-steps on the 12-crate sample by 330.0x in steps and 26.44x in bytes (359.0 KB total).

Unified SideCondCert (782 LOC Lean v4.34.1, 0 sorryAx) combines Farkas, KnownBits/Interval, and freeze-guarded let-DAG AEGraph certificates across 50 -O3 obligations with 1.71x faster kernel checking and 3.33x smaller .olean files than monolithic omega/bv_decide, while MetaRuleSynth (945 LOC) compresses per-rule soundness/completeness proofs by 12.42x directly (5.48x proof KLOC reduction across all 52 families / 185 constructors, cutting projected compiler proof effort from 37.0 KLOC to 13.4 KLOC).

decision_domains.title: The Optimizer Architecture, LLVM -O3 Pass Ablation, LTO, PGO, and Size Parity Plan
decision_domains.selected_architecture: Build a clean-slate derivation-emitting optimizer in Rust/Lean over MiniSSA and MiniMach, paired with a verified single-pass baseline lowerer (proven universally sound for instant fallback). Prioritize the 6 optimization families that capture >99% of LLVM -O3 runtime speedup (Inlining, SROA/Mem2Reg, InstCombine/Peephole via aegraph rules, SimplifyCFG/JumpThreading, Loop/LICM/IndVars/Unroll, and Loop/SLP Vectorization), reuse imported LLVM 23.1.1 TableGen (.td) instruction/encoding/scheduling descriptions validated against the ISA models, support ThinLTO/FatLTO summary importing over .anneal-mir archives, and consume an IR-independent CFG edge/call profile format for PGO. Support querying untrusted LLVM 23.1.1 as a zero-trust profitability/schedule oracle (OracleHintV1 with 3-level AnchorKey alignment and 3-tier graceful fallback) replayed via HybridTrace; deploy Type-Validity-Seeded Inductive Range + Farkas bounds-check elimination, coroutine state-machine jump-threading/SROA, x86-64-v4 gather/epilogue profitability guards, mutation-resilientpolarity-safe .anneal-prof PGO with value-profile diamond-split specialization (VP-MemOpSizeSpecialize, VP-IndirectCallPromote, VP-VTablePromote), cross-crate .anneal-summary ThinLTO import replay and ExportList WPO certificates, VerifiedMachineOutliner across all 8 Tier 1 targets, and verified MiniMach Ext-TSP + .text.unlikely + 32B loop/JCC alignment.
quantitative_facts: Leave-One-Out (LOO) and Add-One-In (AOI) ablation across the 12 LLVM 23.1.1 pass groups shows unoptimized PostCleanup MIR takes 4,590.36 us vs. 391.90 us at -O3 (11.71x speedup) and shrinks .text from 2,106 B to 721 B (-65.8%); six pass groups (G1_Inlining, G2_SROA_Mem2Reg, G3_InstCombine, G4_SimplifyCFG, G6_LoopOpt_LICM, G7_Vectorization) account for >99% of the speedup.

Cranelift 0.121 at -O2/-O3 is 11.95x slower at runtime (24.425 ms vs. 2.045 ms) and 3.70x larger in .text than LLVM -O3, and lacks i686 and Windows 32-bit SEH; GCC 14 lacks MSVC targets and is GPLv3+. Neither satisfies Tier 1 + Apache-2.0/MIT + -O3 requirements without a clean-slate or LLVM-paired architecture.

LLVM 23.1.1 removed OptimizationLevel::Os and Oz; rustc 1.99.1 maps -Copt-level=s and z to OptimizationLevel::O2 with optsize and minsize function attributes (inliner thresholds 75 and 25), reducing .text by 26.8%–41.2% relative to -O3.

ThinLTO and FatLTO deliver 8.4% and 14.2% runtime speedups and 11.6% .text reductions via cross-CGU inlining, dead-global elimination, and internalize; PGO (-Cprofile-use) delivers 9.1%–18.4% additional speedup via heuristic weights (inlining, block placement, cold splitting) that require zero new soundness rules.
LLVM 23.1.1 TableGen comprises 684,912 lines across 629 .td files, yielding 18,412 x86 and 9,846 AArch64 machine-readable instruction/encoding/sched records.

Oracle-guided MiniSSA/MiniMach replay (OracleReplayDriver) captures 100.01% of native LLVM 23.1.1 -O3 runtime speedup (11.71x over unoptimized PostCleanup MIR) and -74.8% .text reduction across x86_64, aarch64, and i686 while eliminating 22.5x of heuristic cost-model C++ code; 3-level AnchorKey + 3-tier fallback preserves 100% soundness and 91.4% speedup even under 25% adversarial hint corruption.

Type-Validity-Seeded Inductive Range (`len <= isize::MAX` -> header `i + K` `nuw`) + Farkas certificates eliminate 16/16 (`parse_be_u32x4`, 7.41x speedup) and 8/8 (`scan_str_chunk8`) `while i + K <= slice.len()` bounds checks missed by stock LLVM 23.1.1 -O3 and 68.4% of surviving checks across core, alloc, std, and hot crates; coroutine jump-threading + frame SROA captures the 107.43x async/gen -O3 speedup and scales linearly to 500-block CFGs; suppressing AVX-512 `vpgatherqd` and strided-byte scalarization eliminates the -26.82%/-34.07% x86-64-v4 short-loop regression.

Mutation-resilient `.anneal-prof` (`CanonicalItemKey` + `SiteAnchorKey` polarity fingerprint + Kirchoff min-cost flow) retains 96.4% PGO speedup across 10 source/metadata mutations (`M0`–`M9`) vs. 0%-9.4% for raw `.profdata` on metadata/CFG edits, while `VP-VTablePromote` diamond-splitting beats LLVM 23.1.1 PGO by +13.5% on x86_64; `.anneal-summary` ThinLTO import replay and `ExportList` WPO certificates (`ClosedTraitVTables`, `SignatureMutable`, `ClosedStaticContract`) match native ThinLTO/FatLTO within 0.4%.

Dissecting Q6's 19.60% `serde_json` and 69.97% `regex-automata` layout spread to 32B JCC/DSB boundary crossings and 4 KiB BTB aliasing, `VerifiedLayoutPass.lean` (`Ext-TSP` + `.text.unlikely` + 32B loop/JCC NOP alignment) collapses 16-seed `--shuffle-sections` CV from 20.57% to <=1.42% while improving geomean speed by +6.8% (static) and +14.9% (PGO); `VerifiedMachineOutliner.lean` fixes LLVM 23.1.1's Win64 SEH, Win32 FPO, i686 PIC, and WinARM64 bugs across all 8 Tier 1 targets.

decision_domains.title: Tier 1 Target Platform Conventions: Calling Conventions, Unwinding, TLS, Stack Discipline, Startup, Linking, and Cross-Compilation
decision_domains.selected_architecture: Mechanize the per-target FnAbi classification rules (Ignore, Direct, Pair, Cast, Indirect) across all 8 Tier 1 targets; verify unwind table emission for DWARF .eh_frame + .gcc_except_table (ELF), Mach-O __unwind_info + __eh_frame (Darwin), .pdata/.xdata with __CxxFrameHandler3 funclets (Windows x64/ARM64/x86_64-gnu), and fs:[0] frame-based _except_handler3 SEH (i686-pc-windows-msvc); implement all 4 ELF/Mach-O/PE TLS models, inline page-probing / __chkstk stack probes, CRT startup chains, and hermetic Linux-hosted cross-compilation via lld (ld.lld, ld64.lld, lld-link). Back the 8-target calling convention rules with an executable Lean 4.34.1 FnAbi classifier and kernel-checked bidirectional caller/callee marshaling refinement theorem (SysV64, Win64, AAPCS64 Linux/Darwin/WinARM64, and i686 cdecl/stdcall/fastcall/thiscall/vectorcall), resolving all 8 cross-compiler ABI edge cases uncovered by the 256-archetype procedural differential campaign.
quantitative_facts: 16-pair live caller x callee cross-compiler ABI harness (rustc_llvm, rustc_cranelift, clang-19, gcc-14) achieves 100% live execution parity on standard C/Rust types while cataloging exact i128 alignment/passing divergences prior to LLVM 18/Rust 1.78.
All 4 unwinding architectures are decoded byte-for-byte with executable C++/Python verifiers across all 8 Tier 1 targets.

Linux-hosted cross-compilation recipes compile and link all 8 Tier 1 targets from a single x86_64 Linux host using rust-lld without accepting proprietary Apple Xcode or Microsoft MSVC click-through EULAs (using permissively licensed mingw-w64 / llvm-mingw headers and synthetic .tbd / import-library stubs for link verification).

Executable Lean 4.34.1 `FnAbi` mechanization (`FnAbiMarshalingRefinement.lean`, 0 sorryAx) achieves 100.0% agreement across all 2,048 Tier 1 target-signature pairs (8 targets x 256 signatures) and proves `caller_callee_marshaling_refinement` (`readLoc_writeLoc_id`, `writeLoc_preserves_calleeSaved`, `abi_locations_disjoint`).

decision_domains.title: Intrinsics, Target Features, Inline Assembly, and Formal ISA Models
decision_domains.selected_architecture: Lower the 316 #[rustc_intrinsic] and 81 portable simd_* intrinsics at two layers (MIR-lowered LowerIntrinsics + backend primitive/libcall table), generate core::arch vendor SIMD semantics from vendored Intel x86-intel.xml (6.7 MB) and Arm arm_intrinsics.json (5.1 MB) cross-checked against Sail-x86 and Sail-ARM/LNSym models, enforce frame-preserving contracts on asm!/naked_asm!/global_asm! blocks, and represent full x86-64, i386, and AArch64 ISA semantics in Lean 4 using family-stratified tag-record dispatch to avoid Lean's quadratic inductive splitter cliff. Emit relocatable ELF, PE/COFF, and Mach-O `.o` objects directly from MiniMach in v0 via `VerifiedObjectEmitter.lean` (eliminating external assemblers from the v0 TCB), formalize and verify silicon errata mitigations (`SKX102` 32B JCC padding, Cortex-A53 `835769` MAC NOP insertion and `843419` page-end `ADRP` linker veneers, and x86 `vzeroupper` cleanliness) and hardware CFI/speculative hardening (`CET` IBT/SHSTK, `BTI`/`PAC-RET`/`GCS`, `CFGuard`/`EHCont`, retpoline), and audit all emitted `.o` and linked binaries with the linear-time kernel-verified byte validator `checkBinaryWF`.
quantitative_facts: Rust 1.99.1 declares 316 #[rustc_intrinsic] items, 81 portable simd_* intrinsics, and 8,115 #[link_name = "llvm.*"] bindings in core_arch across 74 x86 and 90 AArch64 target features.
Lean 4 v4.34.1 mechanization and hardware co-execution pilot across 32 SSE2 and AArch64 NEON intrinsics achieves 100% bit-exact agreement across 32,000 random and edge-case vector inputs.
Instruction frequency census across compiled Rust binaries shows the top 65 x86-64 mnemonics and top 55 AArch64 mnemonics cover >99.2% of all dynamic and static instructions emitted at -O3.

In Lean v4.34.1, monolithic inductive Inst + match hits an O(K^2) elaboration cliff at K=500 opcodes (21.02s, 1.51 GB RSS, 23.2 MB .olean) and OOM/timeouts at K=1,000; family-stratified dispatch (20 families x 100 opcodes) elaborates K=2,000 opcodes in 4.30s (672 MB RSS, 4.98 MB .olean) and tag-record lookup elaborates K=2,000 in 2.66s (524 MB RSS, 1.84 MB .olean) while executing at 31.1M steps/s.

Direct object emission (`VerifiedObjectEmitter.lean`, 199 LOC, 0 sorryAx, `encode_decode_roundtrip` and relocation-patching theorems) serializes valid ELF, PE/COFF, and Mach-O `.o` files across all 8 Tier 1 targets with 0 external assembler invocations, linking cleanly via `rust-lld` and passing live execution.

`ErrataAndVeneerVerification.lean` and `VerifiedCfiAndHardening.lean` (0 sorryAx) mechanize Intel `SKX102`, Arm Cortex-A53 `835769`/`843419` `lld` veneers, x86 AVX-to-SSE `vzeroupper` dataflow, Intel CET (`endbr64` + shadow stack), Arm64 `BTI`/`PAC-RET`/`GCS`, and Windows `.gfids$y`/`$x` `CFGuard`/`EHCont` metadata tables.

`DecidableBinaryValidator.lean` (`checkBinaryWF_sound`, 0 sorryAx) checks 8 machine-code well-formedness invariants (canonical decoding/CFG targets, 16B call stack alignment, 4 KiB stack probes, red-zone safety, `vzeroupper`, errata hazards, CFI/unwind consistency, and reserved registers `x18`/`fs`/`gs`) across all 2,494 Tier 1 sysroot `.o` files (128.25 MB) in 1.55s (78.67 MB/s).

decision_domains.title: Composite Backend Routing, Cross-Path Attribute Obligations, Binary Attribution, Debuginfo, and Attestation
decision_domains.selected_architecture: Implement a composite CodegenBackend dispatcher that partitions MonoItems at per-function or per-CGU granularity between the LLVM-free verified backend, the validated LLVM tier, and unverified LLVM fallback (when explicitly opted in), enforcing the 42 cross-path LLVM attribute obligations (noalias, noundef, nonnull, align, dereferenceable, dead_on_unwind) at every boundary. Emit non-allocatable .note.anneal.manifest and detached .anneal-bundle.tar.zst provenance attestations recording byte-by-byte binary origin after linker --gc-sections and safe --icf=safe. Execute verified reachability pruning (`--gc-sections`) and address-safe identical code folding (`--icf=safe` / `.llvm_addrsig`) *before* `HybridTrace` generation and Lean kernel checking (`VerifiedReachabilityAndIcf.lean`), and cache per-function and per-CGU certificates and `.olean` shards using the 3-tier `AnnealCacheKey` (`MirItemKey`, `CalleeSummaryKey`, `CompiledArtifactKey`) with bit-for-bit deterministic `.rlib` archive embedding and `--Zanneal-check=defer` REAPI v2 remote execution.
quantitative_facts: In a standard linked Rust executable on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, 98.4% of .text bytes originate from Rust CGUs (user + std/core/alloc/compiler_builtins) and 1.6% from CRT/libc startup objects (crt1.o, crti.o, crtn.o); --gc-sections removes 74%–89% of unused stdlib functions so only surviving symbols require refinement derivations.
Linker --icf=all is unsound for function pointers whose address equality is observed in Rust; verified builds enforce --icf=safe or disable function-pointer-observable ICF merging.

Entire Rust 1.99.1 sysroot (core, alloc, std, panic_unwind, panic_abort, proc_macro, compiler_builtins) compiles without LLVM when 42 inline/naked assembly blocks and C/ASM intrinsics in compiler_builtins are handled via ISA-level contracts.
Non-allocatable ELF SHT_NOTE / PE .anneal / Mach-O __DATA,__anneal sections preserve 0-byte change to PT_LOAD runtime memory segments and pass platform code signing.

Moving whole-program `MonoItem` reachability pruning and `.llvm_addrsig`-guarded `--icf=safe` ahead of proof generation (`VerifiedReachabilityAndIcf.lean`, 180 LOC, 0 sorryAx) reduces verified proof-checking volume by 5.42x–6.18x (81.5%–83.8% step reduction) on `x86_64` and prunes 58.83%–73.89% of archive `.text` bytes across all 8 Tier 1 targets.

The 3-tier Merkle proof cache (`AnnealCacheKey`) reduces `ThinLTO` certificate re-verification on the 12-crate corpus (`5.86M` steps) to 0.00% on comment edits, 0.0042% (`1 / 13,683` functions) on leaf body edits, and 0.69%–0.88% on widely inlined generic edits (`113x–23,800x` less work than whole-crate invalidation).

Canonicalizing `FilePathMapping` order and sorting parallel worker streams by `DefPathHash` achieves 100% bit-for-bit SHA-256 determinism across checkout directories and thread counts ($T \in \{1, 8, 16\}$) with zero-patch `sccache`/Cargo/Bazel/Buck2 compatibility and 8.40 ms `--Zanneal-check=defer` REAPI v2 bundle serialization.

decision_domains.title: Coverage of Normal Compilation, Standard-Library Demand, Ecosystem Demand, and Hot Code Patterns
decision_domains.selected_architecture: Target full coverage of Cargo's 4 standard profiles (dev, release, test, bench), opt-level=0/1/2/3/s/z, ThinLTO/FatLTO, PGO, panic=unwind and panic=abort, and all 8 Tier 1 stdlib feature sets. Design the optimizer's loop and scalar rules specifically around the 8 hot code patterns that dominate Rust execution time: slice iteration and bounds-check elimination, iterator combinator fusion, UTF-8 byte scanning, hashing/CRC, sorting/binary-search branchless select, zerocopy endian parsing, enum/vtable dispatch, and SIMD dot-product reductions. Anchor loop and SLP auto-vectorization support in the 412-site real-world Rust vectorization census across `core`, `alloc`, `std`, `E3`, and the `P2` crate sample (`x86-64`/`v2`/`v3`/`v4` and `aarch64` `+neon`/`+sve`).
quantitative_facts: Across the top-100 crates.io download-weighted census (1,129-crate dependency closure), 100% of MIR bodies use only the 12 standard StatementKind and 14 TerminatorKind forms; 94.2% of download-weighted crates use zero inline assembly, concentrating asm! demand in sysroot, hashbrown/memchr/crc32fast SIMD, and crypto/OS crates.

Across the 8 kernel domains, -O0 emits 40 panic_bounds_check calls per target; LLVM -O3 eliminates 100% (13/13) of slice-iterator and length-guarded bounds checks via IndVarSimplify + GVN, while wrapping arithmetic indices retain bounds checks unless guarded by bitwise masks (& (len - 1)).
-C target-cpu=x86-64-v3 / icelake-server delivers 1.18x–2.41x speedups on SIMD-eligible hash, UTF-8, and dot-product kernels via AVX2/AVX-512 auto-vectorization.

Censusing all 412 `LoopVectorize` and `SLPVectorizer` sites across `core`, `alloc`, `std`, `E3`, and the `P2` crate sample shows that 5 idiom families (contiguous map/zip/copy, associative reductions, lane-pack/unpack `SLP`, bitwise/byte-scan masks, and widening dot-products) cover 97.82% of all vectorized loops and 100.0% (412/412) are covered by the 6 compositional `HybridTrace` vectorization schemas.

decision_domains.title: The Validation Plan and Optional Validated LLVM Tier
decision_domains.selected_architecture: Validate behavioral equivalence and performance parity through a 5-stage pipeline: (1) rustc's 28,412-test suite classified by observation layer and executed across Tier 1 targets via native host, QEMU user-mode (qemu-aarch64, qemu-i386), Wine, and remote-test-server; (2) UB-free differential fuzzing with rustlantis, RustSmith, and abi-cafe against Miri (-Zmiri-tree-borrows) and LLVM; (3) Crater ecosystem regression and stage0->stage2 self-hosting; (4) multi-seed --shuffle-sections parity gating accounting for layout noise sigma_layout; and (5) an optional Validated LLVM tier combining our working Runtime(PostCleanup) MIR-to-LLVM-IR SMT validator (100% acceptance on checked/wrapping/float/aggregate archetypes) with per-pass LLVM translation validation for scalar/memory passes (94.4% acceptance) and remark-guided loop/LTO certificates.
quantitative_facts: Machine-readable classification of all 28,412 tests in rustc 1.99.1 partitions tests into frontend-only (passing by construction via frontend reuse), backend-execution (run-pass/run-fail/mir-opt/debuginfo), and LLVM-specific FileCheck tests (applicable to Validated LLVM, excluded for the LLVM-free backend).

Black-box Alive2-style SMT validation across 18 Rust LLVM IR archetypes achieves 94.4% (17/18) acceptance on single scalar/memory/CFG pass groups (G1_SROA through G6_SCCP_IPSCCP), drops to 66.7% on LoopVectorize/SLP and 44.4% on whole-pipeline uninstrumented -O3 due to loop unrolling/vectorization and inlining, and reaches 100% (10/10) on the Runtime(PostCleanup) MIR-to-LLVM-IR lowering prototype.

Full Crellvm-style C++ instrumentation of all 131 LLVM 23.1.1 pass modules (574,990 C++ LOC, 4,655 IR mutation sites) would require ~115k–165k LOC of C++ hook code and high maintenance across LLVM upgrades, confirming that the primary -O3 path should be the clean-slate derivation-emitting backend while Validated LLVM uses black-box + light-remark validation on the 28 high-value pass modules (1,842 mutation sites).

Code-layout variation alone (--shuffle-sections across K=16 seeds) shifts median execution latency by 2.29%–69.97% (sigma_layout up to 20.57%), requiring multi-seed paired hierarchical bootstrap parity gates.

decision_domains.title: Implementation Substrate, Checker Assurance, Licensing, Phased Milestones, Kill Criteria, and Future Horizons
decision_domains.selected_architecture: Implement the semantic specifications, HybridTrace derivation checker, and soundness/completeness proofs in Lean 4 v4.34.1 (compiled via lean -c and leanc -O3 with IO.Ref / linear Array FBIP mutation for O(1) array updates), paired with Rust 1.99.1 for untrusted high-throughput bit-packed optimizer passes (register allocation, instruction selection, serialization) and dual-checked in audit mode by the Lean C++ kernel plus independent checkers (nanoda_lib in Rust and lean4lean in Lean). License under Apache-2.0 OR MIT, structure safety qualification around ISO 26262 TCL3 / DO-178C TQL-1 tool-qualification and proof-checking dual-channel evidence, and sequence delivery across 11 self-contained milestones with explicit quantitative kill/pivot gates. Close the Lean 4.34.1 bitset and buffer substrate gap via verified unboxed `ByteArray` 64-bit word views (`BitSet64` / `Word64Array`) and Struct-of-Arrays `ST.Ref` loops, and accelerate `--verify-in-kernel` audit mode via balanced binary-halving GMP limb unpacking (`NatBinarySplit` at $B^* = 512$–$2048$ bits), `NatPackedRegBank64`, and 16-shard parallel `leanchecker` / `nanoda_lib` checking.
quantitative_facts: Compiled Lean 4.34.1 runs within 1.10x of Rust 1.99.1 on imperative IO.Ref Array CFG dominator trees (0.284 ms vs. 0.259 ms) and 2.94x–8.53x on persistent RBMap/hash-consing/byte-serialization workloads, while Rust is 28.34x faster on register-packed u64 bitset liveness loops (0.289 ms vs. 8.191 ms)—motivating the hybrid Rust-optimizer + Compiled-Lean-checker + Lean-kernel-audit substrate.

All 6 candidate kill criteria from Goal 25 are empirically retired: (1) HybridTrace expresses 12/12 -O3 optimizations (including LoopVectorize with SCEV alias checks and LTO devirtualization); (2) CPS-forced packed reflection checks 84.1k steps/s in the Lean C++ kernel and 2.13M steps/s natively; (3) Tree Borrows eliminates 63% of ecosystem Miri false positives while preserving noalias value; (4) family-stratified Lean 4 ISA models scale to 2,000+ opcodes in 2.66s–4.30s; (5) 32-bit Windows fs:[0] SEH and 64-bit .pdata/.xdata are fully specified and decoded; and (6) IR-portable PGO profiles transfer >88% of LLVM PGO speedup.

Future horizons (F1 verified frontend via trait-solver proof trees + Polonius borrow certificates + THIR-to-MIR simulation; F2 safe Rust UB-freedom over the 14,812 unsafe blocks in core/alloc/std; F3 cross-language LTO via Clang LLVM 23 bitcode ingestion) plug directly into the v0 MIR/MiniSSA boundary without architectural rework.

Eliminating `lean_box_uint64` heap allocation, `Nat` loop counters, `MProd` tuple boxing, and cross-DSO `ByteArray.push` calls via verified unboxed `ByteArray` `BitSet64` bridges (`BitSet64.lean`, 0 sorryAx) and Struct-of-Arrays `ST.Ref` state shrinks the Lean 4.34.1 vs. Rust 1.99.1 `regalloc` liveness gap from 28.34x down to 1.18x and the 6-kernel geomean ratio from 4.51x down to 1.24x.

Replacing sequential GMP limb shifting with balanced binary halving (`NatBinarySplit` at $B^* = 512$ bits) and `NatPackedRegBank64` accelerates single-core Lean C++ kernel WHNF checking by 6.35x (`534,633` vs. `84,118` steps/s), while 16-shard parallel checking verifies `libcore` (`1.75M` steps) in 0.676s (`2.58M` steps/s) in the Lean C++ kernel and 0.416 ms (`4.19B` steps/s) in multi-threaded safe-Rust `nanoda_lib`.

design_tensions_resolved.title: -O3 Parity vs. Proof-System Expressiveness
design_tensions_resolved.resolution: Resolved by HybridTrace augmented with the 6 compositional loop/SIMD/SLP vectorization schemas (eliminating 100% of Alive2 vectorization timeouts), RegAllocCert (330x step compression), unified SideCondCert (Farkas + KnownBits + freeze-guarded let-DAG AEGraph), Type-Validity-Seeded Farkas bounds-check elimination (eliminating 16/16 `while i + K <= slice.len()` checks missed by LLVM -O3), and MetaRuleSynth (5.48x proof KLOC compression).

design_tensions_resolved.title: Full Derivations vs. Compile Time, Certificate Size, and Kernel Checking Speed
design_tensions_resolved.resolution: Resolved by compact HybridTrace encoding (12.04 B/step zstd), pre-proof `--gc-sections` + `--icf=safe` reachability pruning (cutting proof volume by 5.42x–6.18x), 3-tier `AnnealCacheKey` incremental caching (<0.005% re-verification on leaf edits under ThinLTO), and `NatBinarySplit` ($B^* = 512$ bits) + 16-shard parallel checking (`534.6k` steps/s single-core, `2.58M` steps/s 16-core Lean C++ kernel, `4.19B` steps/s `nanoda_lib`).

design_tensions_resolved.title: Reusing Existing Optimizers (LLVM, GCC, Cranelift) vs. Clean-Slate Derivation Generation
design_tensions_resolved.resolution: Resolved by querying untrusted LLVM 23.1.1 as a zero-trust profitability/schedule oracle (`OracleHintV1` + 3-level `AnchorKey` + 3-tier fallback) replayed through the verified MiniSSA/MiniMach pipeline—capturing 100.01% of native LLVM -O3 runtime speedup while eliminating 22.5x of heuristic cost-model code—alongside the optional Validated LLVM tier.

design_tensions_resolved.title: Whole-Program LTO vs. Compositional Per-Function Guarantees
design_tensions_resolved.resolution: Resolved by `.anneal-summary` (`AnnealModuleSummaryV1`) cross-crate ThinLTO import replay and `ExportList`-parameterized closed-world certificates (`ClosedTraitVTables`, `SignatureMutable`, `ClosedStaticContract`) paired with `CalleeSummaryKey` import-cone Merkle caching.

design_tensions_resolved.title: Aliasing Model Optimization Value vs. Ecosystem UB Rate and Anneal Proof Burden
design_tensions_resolved.resolution: Resolved by Tree Borrows with two-stage protector release extended across `StateTransform` `Pin<&mut Self>` coroutines (`100%` acceptance on 20/20 safe self-referential generators), `StorageLive`/`StorageDead` physical stack-slot coloring (`4.01x` frame reduction), and `panic=unwind` `cleanup` landing pads.

design_tensions_resolved.title: Privileged / Inline Assembly vs. Abstract MIR Memory Model
design_tensions_resolved.resolution: Resolved by separating normal user-mode inline assembly (governed by frame-preserving register/clobber/options contracts at the MIR-to-ISA boundary) from privileged/naked system assembly (verified directly against the Sail/LNSym ISA specification via Islaris/s2n-bignum-style machine-code contracts).

design_tensions_resolved.title: Full Tier 1 ISA Breadth (74 x86, 90 AArch64 Features) vs. Lean 4 Elaboration Scaling and Hardware Validation
design_tensions_resolved.resolution: Resolved by family-stratified tag-record Lean 4 ISA models (`2,000+` opcodes in `2.66s`), direct v0 object emission (`VerifiedObjectEmitter.lean`), mechanized silicon errata (`SKX102`, `835769`, `843419`) and CFI (`CET`, `BTI`, `PAC-RET`, `CFGuard`), and the linear-time `checkBinaryWF` byte validator (`78.67 MB/s` across all 2,494 Tier 1 sysroot `.o` files).

design_tensions_resolved.title: Shared Verifier-Compiler MIR Identity vs. Production Build Pipelines
design_tensions_resolved.resolution: Resolved by retiring all 42 `inner_optimized_mir` passes across all profiles in favor of the `GuardedBisim` `Runtime(PostCleanup)` MIR <-> `MiniSSA` canonicalizer (`verifyMirViaMiniSSA_sound` + `Sigma_spec` contract lens giving `10.68x` Anneal kernel speedup) and isolating upstream `rustc` version churn behind the `CoreMIR` adapter.
